activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Visitors mustn't use the cloakroom.
cards.explanation: Una opción se expresa con «don't have to use»; «mustn't» la prohibiría.

cards.statement: Visitors mustn't go beyond this point.
cards.explanation: «Mustn't go» comunica una prohibición directa.

cards.statement: You mustn't upload the file, but uploading it is entirely optional.
cards.explanation: «Mustn't» prohíbe la acción; una acción opcional está permitida pero no es obligatoria.

cards.statement: Do you know whether does Mina have to attend the briefing?
cards.explanation: No hay inversión dentro de la pregunta indirecta: «whether Mina has to attend».

cards.statement: You don't have to borrow a helmet from reception; you can use your own.
cards.explanation: «Don't have to» permite elegir, y la segunda cláusula ofrece una alternativa.

cards.statement: Yesterday, the technicians musted restart the system.
cards.explanation: «Musted» no existe; una obligación pasada usa «had to restart».

cards.statement: Do cyclists have to use this lane?
cards.explanation: La pregunta plural usa correctamente «Do cyclists have to».

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Passengers mustn't open the doors while the bus is moving.
cards.explanation: «Mustn't open» indica que abrir las puertas está prohibido.

cards.statement: From July, every imported device will have to be tested locally.
cards.explanation: «Will have to be tested» combina obligación futura con una pasiva correcta.

cards.statement: Employees must to lock the office at night.
cards.explanation: Después de «must» no se usa «to»: «must lock».

cards.statement: Could you tell me if contractors have to sign in every morning?
cards.explanation: La pregunta indirecta mantiene el orden «contractors have to».

cards.statement: You don't have to take photographs in the conservation room.
cards.explanation: «Don't have to» significa que no es necesario; para una prohibición se necesita «mustn't».

cards.statement: Did the players have to arrive two hours early?
cards.explanation: La pregunta pasada usa «Did + sujeto + have to + infinitivo».

cards.statement: Participants mustn't bring lunch because the organiser provides it.
cards.explanation: La comida proporcionada elimina la necesidad, pero no implica prohibición: «don't have to bring».

cards.statement: We had to submit monthly reports last year, but next year we won't have to submit them.
cards.explanation: «Had to» marca obligación pasada y «won't have to» ausencia de necesidad futura.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Does Aisha has to collect the keys before six?
cards.explanation: Después de «Does» debe aparecer la forma base: «have to collect».

cards.statement: My sister have to renew her library card.
cards.explanation: El sujeto singular requiere «has to renew».

cards.statement: We had to carry paper maps on earlier trips, but we don't have to carry them now.
cards.explanation: El contraste usa correctamente «had to» en el pasado y «don't have to» en el presente.

cards.statement: You don't have to join the guided tour, so you may explore the public rooms independently.
cards.explanation: La segunda opción confirma que la visita guiada no es obligatoria.

cards.statement: You won't have to queue once the new ticket gates open.
cards.explanation: «Won't have to queue» expresa correctamente ausencia de necesidad futura.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: All swimmers have to wear a cap in this pool.
cards.explanation: «Swimmers have to wear» forma correctamente una obligación con sujeto plural.

cards.statement: The storm damaged the roof, so we had to cancel the class.
cards.explanation: «Had to cancel» expresa una obligación causada por una situación pasada.

cards.statement: The hotel offered free transfers, so guests didn't had to arrange a taxi.
cards.explanation: Después de «didn't» se usa la forma base: «didn't have to arrange».

cards.statement: You must keep your receipt.
cards.explanation: «Must» va seguido correctamente de la forma base «keep».

cards.statement: Next season, the club will have to replace the floodlights.
cards.explanation: «Will have to replace» es la forma normal de obligación futura.
